scope: Freeze the root product decision and implementation design contract for a dedicated trajectory inset/minimap. The inset is a new semantic and rendering plane that preserves canonical trajectory geometry without relying on the failed main-world crossing grammars. This artifact is design-only and does not authorize or perform production, CMake, GPU, readiness, capture, machine, TA, human-study or product changes.

root_product_decision_binding.statement: ROOT PRODUCT DECISION: SELECT D DEDICATED_TRAJECTORY_INSET_MINIMAP. A/B/C are not selected. Main-world overlay becomes secondary/diagnostic and no prior machine pass transfers. Design-only; no production/CMake/GPU/readiness/authorization.
root_product_decision_binding.selected_reason: The implementation is larger, but it does not distort the true world projection, remove route information or introduce temporal flashing; among the reviewed choices it has the lowest product-semantic and accessibility risk.

product_semantics.entitlement: Reuse the existing training/replay trajectory-assist entitlement only; do not expose the inset in modes where trajectory assistance is currently unavailable.

default_layout_and_ui_contract.coordinate_system: top-left physical pixels at 96-DPI reference before the existing 85-135 percent user-scale transform
default_layout_and_ui_contract.plot_aspect_ratio: 2:1 play-surface orientation; head rail at bottom and foot spot toward top for every camera
default_layout_and_ui_contract.modal_behavior: A blocking rules/modal state suppresses the inset with explicit inset_suppressed_by_modal telemetry; it never relocates unpredictably or enables the world overlay.
default_layout_and_ui_contract.layout_collision_behavior: If the deterministic reference layout cannot satisfy all exclusions after the existing user-scale transform, suppress the inset with inset_layout_unavailable; do not overlap, shrink below minimum, move by scene content or change camera.
legend_entries_in_order: ACTUAL / 实际 — paired continuous rails

inset_visual_grammar.projection: Camera-independent top-down mapping from canonical table coordinates into the fixed 2:1 plot rectangle. Player/elevated/overhead/broadcast camera matrices are never inputs to inset geometry.
inset_visual_grammar.actual_track: Two continuous symmetric actual-attributed rails flank the exact canonical actual centerline. Their midpoint is the unmodified route; neither rail replaces or offsets the canonical source geometry.
inset_visual_grammar.predicted_track: Predicted route remains on the exact canonical centerline and uses a dashed core with independent halo and side rim.
inset_visual_grammar.overlap_behavior: At coaxial overlap, predicted centerline dashes remain visually dominant while both actual rails remain continuously traceable outside the predicted complete silhouette; no source route is erased, clipped, recolored or time-sliced.
inset_visual_grammar.actual_endpoint: Paired-rail capsule endpoint plus outward direction notch

standard_palette.actual: deep cyan with white local halo
standard_palette.predicted: warm yellow with dark local halo

inset_visual_grammar.fixed_panel_background: opaque low-luminance neutral panel; no scene-color sampling, adaptive polarity or main-world depth/occlusion

independent_semantic_plane_contract.token_namespace: Dedicated nonzero insetOwnershipToken namespace; numeric tokens are never reused from or compared with main-world finalOwnershipToken values.
independent_semantic_plane_contract.common_parent_source_key: trajectory generation id + track + canonical analytic arcSegmentId + route-order ordinal + collision/event lineage
independent_semantic_plane_contract.world_member_key: common parent source key + world primitiveId + world componentRole + world visualSublayer + world finalOwnershipToken, or explicit world_not_emitted reason
independent_semantic_plane_contract.inset_member_key: common parent source key + inset primitiveId + inset componentRole + inset visualSublayer + insetOwnershipToken
independent_semantic_plane_contract.mapping_ledger_row: Exactly one common parent source key with the ordered complete world member set and ordered complete inset member set; missing, duplicate, foreign, mixed-generation or color-derived association fails closed.
independent_semantic_plane_contract.inset_source_group_denominator: Every canonical actual or predicted analytic route source intersecting the play surface before camera projection, including sources whose main-world member is clipped or un-emitted.
independent_semantic_plane_contract.inset_semantic_member_denominator: All required inset roles emitted from every source group: actual left/right rail cores and their halos, predicted dash core/inner halo/outer rim, and deterministic endpoint/direction markers where the canonical source contract requires them.
independent_semantic_plane_contract.inset_probe_denominator: One deterministic InsetTrajectoryProbe per inset core or marker semantic member, carrying stroke, companion/halo and fixed-panel-background sample locations plus parent source and exact inset member identity.
denominator_exclusions: legend, border, title, toggle and focus UI
main-world contrast probes and the historical ordered-81 denominator
framebuffer color, repair coordinates, prior pass/fail and product mode name
independent_semantic_plane_contract.ordered_probe_count_and_digest: New inset-only count and digest must be frozen by the future CPU implementation receipt; neither value exists or passes in this design gate.
required_mapping_results: 100 percent of inset source-group denominator rows have one common parent source
100 percent of required inset semantic members have one nonzero uniform insetOwnershipToken batch
100 percent of inset probe denominator records resolve to one exact inset member and one fixed background sample
zero orphan, duplicate, foreign, mixed-generation or main-world-token-derived inset members

render_resource_and_pass_contract.direct_hdr_scene_fbo_rejected_reason: A direct draw can partially contaminate the main HDR target before a later GL failure is observed and cannot guarantee zero inset pixels/tokens on the failed frame. Reusing the main semantic attachment also collapses the independent inset plane and denominator.
required_independent_resources: inset HDR color attachment and framebuffer
inset per-sample R32UI semantic attachment and framebuffer
inset resolved per-sample semantic attachment preserving 1, 2 or 4 ownership tokens
dedicated inset geometry buffer, vertex array and programs
render_resource_and_pass_contract.inset_tone_contract: Fixed palette transfer and sRGB encode independent of main-scene exposure, ACES adaptation, scene backdrop and camera; alpha remains explicit for panel composition.
render_resource_and_pass_contract.main_final_ownership_behavior: Main-world final-ownership instrumentation receives at most one inset panel-container UI token. Trajectory source ownership remains exclusively in the independent inset semantic plane and denominator.

required_checks: program compile and link status plus complete logs
sample-count and format support query with immediate glGetError check
every inset texture/buffer allocation and upload with immediate glGetError check
every inset framebuffer completeness check after attachment or resize
semantic and color clear success before every frame
color and per-sample semantic resolve success
gl_fail_closed_contract.on_any_failure: Abort both inset trajectory and inset legend composite for that frame, publish one stable inset error code, retain the user's inset toggle state as requested-but-unavailable, and never auto-enable or claim success from the main-world overlay.
gl_fail_closed_contract.stale_resource_policy: A failed, resized, context-lost or generation-mismatched frame invalidates all inset color, semantic, mapping, probe and denominator state before the next frame.
gl_fail_closed_contract.required_consecutive_frame_negative: valid frame N -> forced query/upload/FBO/resolve failure at N+1 -> recovered valid frame N+2; N+1 composites zero inset pixels/tokens and N+2 cannot reuse N mappings or textures.

future_cpu_static_acceptance_not_execute.case_order: layout profile major, then camera, palette and sample profile
required_invariants: inset canonical geometry, source mapping and denominator digests are camera-independent across all four camera presets
standard and CVD semantic topology, source mapping, denominator and connected-component digests are identical
1x, 2x and 4x use the exact asymmetric sample positions and preserve per-sample tokens rather than relabeling one raster
actual paired rails are continuously traceable through every predicted dash-on and dash-gap interval without altering the canonical midpoint route
predicted centerline dash rhythm, endpoint and direction remain readable and dominant
default layout, safe area, footer clearance, legend, toggles, bilingual names and modal suppression satisfy the layout contract
world overlay default-off secondary state and inset default-on state are independent and no historical world pass is inherited
all GL query, upload, FBO, resolve and consecutive-frame negatives fail closed

missing, zero, duplicate, mixed-generation, foreign or world-token-reused inset semantic member
world clipping or visibility removes an inset source denominator row
legend or UI element enters the inset trajectory denominator
historical 81 probe count/digest substituted for the inset probe inventory
actual rail midpoint deviates from the canonical route or only one rail survives
predicted centerline, dash gap, endpoint or direction marker is removed
layout overlaps an exclusion, shrinks below minimum or relocates from scene content
modal suppression enables the world overlay
sample-query, allocation, upload, FBO, resolve, tone or composite GL failure
valid-fail-valid consecutive frames reuse stale texture, semantic, mapping, probe or denominator state
production/CMake file outside a future explicitly authorized allowlist changes

future_targeted_gpu_ta_and_human_gates_n.minimum_future_gpu_matrix: player/elevated/overhead/broadcast standard controls plus broadcast CVD, with 1x/2x/4x semantic receipts and original-resolution color captures
independent_ta_axes: actual paired-rail continuity and midpoint fidelity
predicted dashed-centerline dominance and gap readability
panel contrast, table orientation and ball/route context
safe-area, HUD, footer, modal and user-scale layout
main-world overlay remains secondary and does not contaminate inset acceptance
human_comprehension_questions: Can participants correctly identify actual versus predicted route without relying on color?
Can participants explain that the inset is a top-down semantic view rather than a change to the world trajectory?
Can keyboard, pointer and screen-reader users find, toggle and understand inset and diagnostic world-guide controls without accidental mode changes?
